dedupe_keys.name: database of damaged and retrofitted soft story buildings from the 19 september 2017 mexico city earthquake

description: Database of Damaged and Retrofitted Soft-Story Buildings from the 19 September 2017 Mexico City Earthquake is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Eric Espinosa Cazarín, Universidad de las Americas Puebla. The present database was derived from a broader building inventory developed initially from the cadaster of Mexico City, which provided information on lot geometry, land use, and construction year. Coverage: Mexico City. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Earthquake, soft-first story, structural system, Occupancy, rehabilitation. Published 2025-12-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
